w: Swamishri arrived at Vachhara village to perform the murti-pratishtha ceremony of a new mandir. The canvas murtis of Akshar and Purushottam, Hanuman and Ganpati and Guru Parampara were instituted with Vedic rites by Swamishri and Balmukund Swami. In the assembly that followed Swamishri said, "One cannot be redeemed by performing fasts or donations or any other meritorious deeds. That is achieved only by doing Satsang. There is an opportunity of Satsang in this village, so may everyone come to it. One should live an addiction-free life. The body needs air, water and food but not addictions ! It is the opinion of Bhagwan Swaminarayan that one should lead an addiction-free life and a moral life.

Many feel what is the need for mandir ? If we have mandirs then we will get good thoughts. So one should respect it, love it and derive benefit from it. You will get something good from it..." 4,000 people had attended the inauguration ceremony..
Swamishri returned back to Gondal at 12.20 p.m.

In the evening, an annual function of Kishore-Yuvak Mandal was held. Pujya Viveksagar Swami talked about Swamishri’s virtuous youths. Several other speeches, bhajans and a drama on Hiramukhi was performed.

Before Swamishri’s blessings, the compere announced that, "May all the honors and awards of the 21st century be awarded to Swamishri." Swamishri began his blessings, "The biggest honor or prize for us is that we have realised God and His holy sadhu. Understanding and spreading his glory is the greatest of honors. We should please him, increase our devotion for him and spread his message from village to village. During his prayer in Mahelav Yogiji Maharaj asked, ' O Shastriji Maharaj, may we realise your divine form.' "Because there is no self-control one gets enticed by worldly attractions. One does not achieve success because of indulging in kusang and drinking and eating outside. At present you should resolve that you want to study well and elevate the society and country. If you have a higher ideal than you will be able to do good things."
Gems From Swamishri
One who has sankhya vichar sees the worldly pleasures as painful and full of misery. If one understands this then one will fare well in life.
Shriji Maharaj has gifted the Shikshapatri to mankind and if one were to live accordingly then the troubles regarding health, society and family would be solved.
Today the evils of T.V., killing, conflicts and indulgence in worldly pleasures have created a number of problems. Peace can only be got through dharma.

On the occasion of the 19th Annual Day celebration of Akshar Purushottam Chhatralay, the hostel students presented a variety of programs in the evening assembly. Speeches and narrations by the students were effectively presented. Two students mimed on the subject of 'Addiction is Death'. Then Swamishri was requested to mime messages to each team. Swamishri gestured and conveyed that they should study and attain first rank and also rank first in spirituality (bhajan). Thereafter, a monoacting on 'Jodha Bharwad' was performed by a student. Then students who had excelled in Satsang, studies, personality development and sports were blessesd and appreciated by Swamishri.
Then a humorous drama was enacted by the hostel students to show the secrets of successful study. Finally, Swamishri addressed the students.
At 9.00 a.m., Swamishri offered flowers at the feet of Shri Nilkanth Varni on the Akshardham podium.
At 6.15 p.m., Swamishri performed arti of Bhagwan Swaminarayan and Guru Parampara on the Akshardham podium.
After his morning puja, Swamishri inaugurated 'Niti Vignan' and 'Bal Sanskar Sahita' - two new publications prepared by sadhus in Sarangpur for the pupils of Pramukh Swami Vidya Mandir.

To commemorate Women's Day, the women devotees of Botad had prepared a 'Bhakti Kumbh' containing 8,484 flowers petals on which the Swaminarayan mantra had been written. They had also recited the Janmangal Namavali (Shriji Maharaj's 108 names) 1,084 times. Also, they had devotionally written the Swaminarayan mantra on 8,484 grains of rice.
At 11.30 a.m. Swamishri inaugurated the new school, administrative and residential buildings for the Pramukh Swami Vidya Mandir.

After speeches by senior sadhus Swamishri blessed the festival assembly, “Bhagatji Maharaj revealed the glory of Gunatitanand Swami as it was. He also prayed to Swami that he did not want anything of this world, but only wanted to make his jiva satsangi. When satsang penetrates into the jiva then one will never fall back from Satsang. The satsang of the body means that one becomes happy on getting food and drinks and praise and honour. And when one does not get it then one falls back. In the satsang of one’s jiva one tends to make do with whatever one has and rejoices in hearing spiritual discourses and having darshan.”

When Swamishri came for darshan in the rupchoki of the mandir, the sadhus sitting here were singing a pad from the Chosath Padi: 'Mano mali chhe moti vat, hath avi te ma harjo re...' (Know that a great thing has been found; do not lose what has come into your hands).
With the words 'great thing' in mind, Swamishri spread both hands wide and asked, "How big?"
Hearing this, Viratswarup Swami, sitting in front, said, "It has become small now." (He had dieted and slimmed down, and spoke with that in mind.)

Hearing this, Swamishri said at once, "The body gains and loses. Slimming is good, but having met Maharaj and Swami, Shastriji Maharaj and Yogiji Maharaj, having received this satsang, that is the great thing. Do not let go of that. Let go of everything else."
A letter came from a young man in Bhavnagar. He wanted Swamishri's blessings on the phone to be freed from addiction.
Swamishri said, "Give up tobacco, bidis, alcohol, meat, all of it. That is all you have to do. Only if you give this up will you be happy."
"I am trying to give it up, but it does not leave me."
Swamishri said, "Believe it is poison. Once you know poison is poison, do you drink it?"
"No."
"In the same way, all this is poison. Just give it up."
"I will give it up from tomorrow."
Swamishri said, "Make the resolve right now. Make a do or die effort."
Swamishri spoke with great strength. So at the end he said, "Shall I come for your darshan tomorrow?"
Swamishri said, "Even if you come here, this is all we will talk about. I have said everything on the phone now. When you come here we cannot talk this much, so this is fine."
